pages.text: $(l)Skirmish$(): a match against the AI without a hero, only the command view. In the main menu the button beside $(l)Singleplayer$(); in a game the pause menu or $(k:key.starmine.skirmish). Choose your race, the AI's race and the map: $(l)Amphion$() (a fresh copy of the prepared map), $(l)a new generated world$() (from the main menu) or $(l)a dimension$() of the world you play.

In a skirmish the land is not broken and no blocks are placed: workers mine crystals and vespene only, blasts break nothing. The whole map is explored from the start and shown on the minimap with its relief, under the fog of war: what your units do not see now is dimmed.
